label: graph-base
statements: CREATE TABLE GNodes (Id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
CREATE TABLE GEdges (Src INT64 NOT NULL, Dst INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Src,Dst)

label: view-gprojection
sql: CREATE VIEW GProjection SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id,GENERATE_UUID() AS V FROM GNodes n

label: view-gbodyuuid
sql: CREATE VIEW GBodyUuid SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id FROM GNodes n WHERE LENGTH(GENERATE_UUID())>0

label: view-gjoinuuid
sql: CREATE VIEW GJoinUuid SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT a.Id FROM GNodes a JOIN GNodes b ON a.Id=b.Id AND LENGTH(GENERATE_UUID())>0
